title: Common themes in your Mall World dreams?
content: I had two more dreams involving a bizarre mall-type setting last night, and noticed they both had the same themes in them, and the same themes have been in nearly all my "mall world" type dreams. These themes are running from something, and fire. Sometimes I set the fire as a distraction or method of defense from whatever I'm running away from, and sometimes I'm running away because I just set a building on fire. Last night's dreams involved me running from some kind of mob and, after being cornered, I set the room on fire and got out of there and it exploded. The other dream involved me running through multiple levels of stores and shopping areas in "Croatia" while searching for a room containing important documents. When I found the archive room, I set it on fire, and then had to run from the guards. Do you have any common themes through your dreams?
